verdict.rationale: GrowthBook docs explicitly show useFeatureValue for non-boolean flags (e.g., buttonColor string default 'blue') alongside useFeatureIsOn for booleans, and targeting/rules docs describe controlling 'which values' a user sees, implying support for arbitrary value types (JSON, numbers, strings) not just booleans. missing for 10: an explicit docs statement enumerating supported flag value types (string/number/JSON) or a dedicated JSON config example, and independent hands-on confirmation of multivariate/JSON flag usage beyond the single string example.
